import copy, json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
from crosscheck.crosscheck import StreamEngine

FAILS = []
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        FAILS.append(name); print('FAIL', name); print('  got ', json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True)[:700]); print('  want', json.dumps(want, sort_keys=True)[:700])
    else:
        print('pass', name)

TOPO = {"nodes": [{"id": 0, "name": "A", "external_capacity": 100},
                  {"id": 1, "name": "B", "external_capacity": 100},
                  {"id": 2, "name": "C", "external_capacity": 100}],
        "links": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "capacity": 60},
                  {"source": 1, "target": 2, "capacity": 60}],
        "external_nodes": ["A", "B", "C"]}
SETTINGS = {"trials": 2, "epsilon": 0, "seed": 21, "cutoff": [0, 1], "bias": 0, "tau": 0,
            "gamma": [1, 1], "cache_slots": 3}
PLAN = {"A": {"B": [{"path": ["A", "B"], "weight": 1000}],
              "C": [{"path": ["A", "B", "C"], "weight": 1000}]},
        "B": {"A": [{"path": ["B", "A"], "weight": 1000}],
              "C": [{"path": ["B", "C"], "weight": 1000}]},
        "C": {"A": [{"path": ["C", "B", "A"], "weight": 1000}],
              "B": [{"path": ["C", "B"], "weight": 1000}]}}
SPLIT = {"A": {"B": [{"path": ["A", "B"], "weight": 400}, {"path": ["A", "B"], "weight": 600}],
              "C": [{"path": ["A", "B", "C"], "weight": 1000}]},
         "B": {"A": [{"path": ["B", "A"], "weight": 1000}],
              "C": [{"path": ["B", "C"], "weight": 1000}]},
         "C": {"A": [{"path": ["C", "B", "A"], "weight": 1000}],
              "B": [{"path": ["C", "B"], "weight": 1000}]}}

def patch(counters):
    return {"op": "patch", "demands": [], "counters": counters}

FULL = {"low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": 10}, "low_B_ingress_from_A": {"perturbed": 10},
        "low_A_origination": {"perturbed": 10}, "low_B_termination": {"perturbed": 10},
        "low_B_egress_to_C": {"perturbed": 6}, "low_C_ingress_from_B": {"perturbed": 6},
        "low_C_termination": {"perturbed": 6}}
ALT = dict(FULL, low_A_egress_to_B={"perturbed": 11})

def run(events, settings=None):
    stream = {"topology": copy.deepcopy(TOPO), "settings": copy.deepcopy(settings or SETTINGS),
              "events": events}
    return StreamEngine(stream).replay(events)

def test_snapshot_replacement():
    events = [{"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": PLAN},
              patch(FULL), {"op": "repair", "id": "X"},
              patch(ALT), {"op": "repair", "id": "X"},
              patch(FULL), {"op": "repair", "id": "Y"},
              {"op": "validate", "id": "X"}, {"op": "validate", "id": "Y"}]
    answers = run(events)
    check('first X miss', answers[2]['cache_hit'], False)
    check('second X miss', answers[4]['cache_hit'], False)
    check('Y hit', answers[6]['cache_hit'], True)
    check('Y equals first publication', answers[6]['links'], answers[2]['links'])
    check('X replaced by second', answers[7]['failed'],
          ['low_A_egress_to_B', 'low_A_origination', 'low_B_ingress_from_A'])
    check('Y validates clean', answers[8]['failed'], [])

def test_same_state_hit():
    events = [patch(FULL), {"op": "repair", "id": "a"},
              patch({"low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": 10}}), {"op": "repair", "id": "b"},
              patch({"low_C_egress_to_B": None}), {"op": "repair", "id": "c"}]
    answers = run(events)
    check('same value patch hits', answers[3]['cache_hit'], True)
    check('null missing cell hits', answers[5]['cache_hit'], True)

def test_demand_zero_normalisation():
    events = [{"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": PLAN},
              {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 2, 7]], "counters": FULL},
              {"op": "repair", "id": "a"},
              {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 2, 0]], "counters": {}},
              {"op": "repair", "id": "b"}]
    answers = run(events)
    check('explicit zero demand hits', answers[4]['cache_hit'], True)

def test_validation_settings_not_identity():
    events = [{"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": PLAN}, patch(FULL), {"op": "repair", "id": "a"}]
    answers = run(events, dict(SETTINGS, cutoff=[1, 3], bias=5, tau=9, gamma=[2, 7]))
    answers2 = run(events, dict(SETTINGS, cutoff=[0, 1], bias=0, tau=0, gamma=[1, 1]))
    check('validation settings are not identity', answers[2]['links'], answers2[2]['links'])

def test_cache_slots_bound():
    for slots in range(0, 4):
        events = [patch(FULL), {"op": "repair", "id": "a"},
                  patch(ALT), {"op": "repair", "id": "b"},
                  patch(FULL), {"op": "repair", "id": "c"},
                  patch(ALT), {"op": "repair", "id": "d"}]
        answers = run(events, dict(SETTINGS, cache_slots=slots))
        hits = [a['cache_hit'] for a in answers if a.get('op') == 'repair']
        if slots == 0:
            expected = [False, False, False, False]
        elif slots == 1:
            # a, b, c(evict a), d(hit b)
            expected = [False, False, False, True]
        else:
            expected = [False, False, True, True]
        check('slots %d' % slots, hits, expected)

def test_routes_replacement():
    events = [{"op": "routes", "label": "one", "paths": PLAN}, patch(FULL), {"op": "repair", "id": "a"},
              {"op": "routes", "label": "two", "paths": SPLIT}, {"op": "repair", "id": "b"},
              {"op": "routes", "label": "three", "paths": PLAN}, {"op": "repair", "id": "c"}]
    answers = run(events)
    check('split plan is a miss', answers[4]['cache_hit'], False)
    check('restored plan hits', answers[6]['cache_hit'], True)
    check('split changes predictions', answers[4]['counters']['low_B_ingress_from_A']['corrected'],
          answers[2]['counters']['low_B_ingress_from_A']['corrected'])

def main():
    test_snapshot_replacement()
    test_same_state_hit()
    test_demand_zero_normalisation()
    test_validation_settings_not_identity()
    test_cache_slots_bound()
    test_routes_replacement()
    print('failures', FAILS)
    return 1 if FAILS else 0

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
